notes.title: Cross play with Xbox Update
notes.content: [p][/p][h2]🍄 Shroom Siege Demo Now Cross-Play with Xbox! ⚔️[/h2][p]Big news, mushroom warriors! 🌟[/p][p]The [b]Shroom Siege demo is now live on Xbox[/b] as part of the Xbox Indie Selects Demo Fest 2025 — and starting today, we’ve added [b]full cross-play support with Steam[/b]![/p][p]That means whether you’re defending shrines or pushing poop with your trusty beetle, you can now [b]team up with friends across Xbox and Steam[/b] in chaotic 4v4 online battles.[/p][h3]🆕 What’s New:[/h3][list][*][p]🔗 [b]Cross-Play Multiplayer[/b] – Steam + Xbox players, united in battle[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ [b]Bigger Community[/b] – More warriors, more action, more mushroom mayhem[/p][/*][*][p]🗺️ [b]Two New Maps Added to the Demo![/b] – Fresh battlegrounds to explore and conquer[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning—your feedback during the demo will help us fine-tune balance and prepare for the full release in 2025.[/p][p]👉 Play the Demo on Steam[/p][p]🍄⚔️ Siege together, anywhere![/p][h3]🍄 [b]NEW MAPS!!!! 🐝🐝🐝🐝[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43980941/f3c19069ce9d3a89215c39473a2ad580400070d4.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🍄 🌸🌺🌼🌻🌷🌹🍄🍄🍄🍄[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43980941/68d2436b485c8d444826a9dbb865a3b655bcfc9f.jpg"][/img][/p]
